# SI010 — unsupported-storage-type

Persistent storage must use GenLayer storage types.

## Why

Plain dict/list/set/float are not valid persistent storage and can change behavior across validators.

## Bad

```python
incidents: dict[str, IncidentRecord]
```

## Good

```python
incidents: TreeMap[str, IncidentRecord]
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI010 -- reason
```

- AGENTS.md §5.7, §19.7
